text: Love righteousness, [2] you who judge the earth; [AA]think of the Lord in goodness,and seek him in integrity of heart; [AB]
Because he is found by those who do not test him,and manifests himself to those who do not disbelieve him. [AC]
For perverse counsels separate people from God,and his power, put to the proof, rebukes the foolhardy; [AD]
t[3] Because into a soul that plots evil wisdom does not enter,nor does she dwell in a body under debt of sin. [AE]
For the holy spirit of discipline [4] flees deceitand withdraws from senseless counselsand is rebuked when unrighteousness occurs. [AF]
For wisdom is a kindly spirit,yet she does not acquit blasphemous lips;Because God is the witness of the inmost self [AG]and the sure observer of the heartand the listener to the tongue. [AH]
For the spirit of the Lord fills the world, [AI]is all-embracing, and knows whatever is said.
Therefore those who utter wicked things will not go unnoticed,nor will chastising condemnation pass them by. [AJ]
For the devices of the wicked shall be scrutinized,and the sound of their words shall reach the Lord,for the chastisement of their transgressions;
Because a jealous ear hearkens to everything, [AK]and discordant grumblings are not secret.
Therefore guard against profitless grumbling,and from calumny [5] withhold your tongues;For a stealthy utterance will not go unpunished,and a lying mouth destroys the soul.
Do not court death [6] by your erring way of life,nor draw to yourselves destruction by the works of your hands.
Because God did not make death, [AL]nor does he rejoice in the destruction of the living.
For he fashioned all things that they might have being,and the creatures of the world are wholesome;There is not a destructive drug among themnor any domain of Hades [7] on earth,
It was the wicked who with hands and words invited death,considered it a friend, and pined for it,and made a covenant with it,Because they deserve to be allied with it. [AN]
